events.name: Adam Hawley
events.info: Guitarist and Producer Dr. Adam Hawley has burst on to the scene as a celebrated and innovative artist, composer and band leader. Handpicked by Maurice White (founder of Earth, Wind, & Fire) he first debuted on the legend's label Kalimba Music. Now helming his own label MBF Entertainment, Adam's seven albums and work as a producer has spawned an incredible 20 Billboard #1 Hits. Additional accolades include 2025 #1 Billboard Artist of the Year, #1 Mediabase artist of the year in 2024, Billboard song of year in 2022 and 2020, and a #1 album in sales as per Nielsen in 2020. Coupling this with a robust touring schedule throughout the world, the best is yet to come.
